items.name: Practice Token
items.description: A wooden chit knocked loose from the training dummy. Proof you connected.

items.name: Leather Cap
items.description: Simple boiled-leather headgear.

items.name: Padded Coif
items.description: Quilted cloth headgear from the training-yard stores.

items.name: Wolf Pelt
items.description: A coarse gray pelt.

items.name: Wolf Fang
items.description: A yellowed fang. A trapper will give you a copper or two for it.

items.name: Worn Kobold Coin
items.description: A clipped, worn coin the kobolds hoard in their diggings. It still spends.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A reliable iron blade.

items.name: Rough Copper Ore
items.description: Unrefined copper ore, barely worth the haul.

items.name: Rugged Fiber
items.description: Coarse plant fiber, good for binding and repairs.

items.name: Beginner's Salvaging Kit
items.description: Simple tools for mending worn gear in the field.

items.name: Copper
items.description: A small ingot of raw copper.

items.name: Training Blade
items.description: A plain, well-balanced blade — kinder than the dummies.

items.name: Recruit's Sword
items.description: A warrior's first blade — plain steel, honest weight.

items.name: Apprentice's Staff
items.description: A worn wooden staff crowned with a dull focus stone.

items.name: Acolyte's Mace
items.description: A simple flanged mace, blessed for a novice's hand.

items.name: Class Primer
items.description: A primer on your calling; its techniques unlock with training.

items.name: Trail Rations
items.description: A pouch of hearty trail rations.

items.name: Bloodthorn Blossom
items.description: A crimson bog blossom, petals slick with sap.

items.name: Recipe: Minor Healing Potion
items.description: Instructions for brewing a Minor Healing Potion.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: A vial of antidote that cures common poisons.

items.name: Novice Cloak
items.description: A faction-aligned cloak; its protective wards activate in time.

items.name: Sealed Outpost Parcel
items.description: A courier parcel bound for the Borderlands outpost. Bram's seal is unbroken.

items.name: Regent's Letter of Introduction
items.description: A sealed introduction addressed to Lord Castellan Berenger of Highkeep.

items.name: Highkeep Vault Voucher
items.description: A formal voucher recognizing its bearer as a client of the Bank of Highkeep.

items.name: Cryptkeeper Chain
items.description: Level 12 chain links scrubbed clean of grave soil.

items.name: Aldric's Oathblade
items.description: Level 13. The fallen knight's vow still gleams along its fuller.

items.name: Aldric's Broken Vow
items.description: Level 13. A battered shield bearing a deliberately scored-out crest.

items.name: Bonepriest Wraps
items.description: Level 13 linen reinforced with thin, unsettling splints.

items.name: Vharis's Drowned Censer
items.description: Level 14. Cold crypt water beads forever on its silver cage.

items.name: Vharis's Flooded Signet
items.description: Level 14. Its blue stone holds a wavering reflection of the sunken crypt.

items.name: Unhallowed Guard
items.description: Level 14 iron made serviceable after centuries underground.

items.name: Gravetide, Maldrath's Edge
items.description: Level 15. Old runes crawl beneath the darkened steel.

items.name: Bone Fragment
items.description: A splinter of yellowed bone from a shattered skeleton. A necromancer would pay for these.

items.name: Grave Dust
items.description: Powdery grey ash that clings to everything the restless dead have touched.

items.name: Tarnished Grave Coin
items.description: An old burial coin, blackened with age. Still spends, if you can stomach where it came from.

items.name: Ghoul Claw
items.description: A hooked, filth-crusted claw wrenched from a crypt ghoul. A reagent for poisons and glue.

items.name: Rusted Grave Blade
items.description: A notched, corroded sword pried from a skeletal warrior's grip. Barely serviceable.

items.name: Spectral Essence
items.description: A cold, shifting wisp of bound soulstuff left behind when a shade is banished. Prized by enchanters.

items.name: Maldrath's Last Shroud
items.description: Level 15. Heavy burial cloth that turns aside more than dust.

items.name: Maldrath's Hollow Crown
items.description: Level 15 epic. The circlet the first Hollowing crowned itself with, wrenched from patient zero. The Era-1 RAID relic (era-direction.md S4.1) — homed by T-473 on the Vault of the First Hollowing's final boss, weekly-locked. Armor 20 = 1.43x the rare head ceiling (Ironward Helm 14), inside the T-353 epic index cap (150 vs rare 100). Carried across the rift, it re-scales one hop and beats everything a fresh Ashmoor arrival can farm.

items.name: Warplate of the Vault Sentinel
items.description: Level 15 epic. Grave-iron harness hammered around whatever still stands watch below the barrow. T-473 raid tier: armor 31 = 1.41x the rare chest ceiling (Ironward Cuirass 22), under the T-353 epic cap.

items.name: Gravewall Aegis
items.description: Level 15 epic. A tomb door cut down to a shield; the mason's tally marks still count the interred. T-473 raid tier: armor 13 = 1.44x the rare offhand ceiling (Aldric's Broken Vow 9), under the T-353 epic cap.

items.name: Knell, the Dirgemother's Tongue
items.description: Level 15 epic. The clapper of a funeral bell, still ringing a note only the dead answer. T-473 raid tier: attack 27 = 1.42x the rare weapon ceiling (Gravetide 19), under the T-353 epic cap.

items.name: Palls of the Drowned Choir
items.description: Level 15 epic. Sodden mourning-cloth draped shoulder to shoulder, heavier than any mail. T-473 raid tier: armor 17 = 1.42x the rare shoulders ceiling (Ironward Pauldrons 12), under the T-353 epic cap.

items.name: Greaves of the Hollow Procession
items.description: Level 15 epic. Leg harness from the honor guard that walked the first Hollowing to its vault — and never walked out. T-473 raid tier: armor 26 = 1.44x the rare legs ceiling (Ironward Greaves 18), under the T-353 epic cap.

items.name: Ironward Helm
items.description: Level 15 plate. A full sallet forged for a knight of the old Ironward guard — no id-substring gives its family away; the armor_type field does.

items.name: Ironward Cuirass
items.description: Level 15 plate. A heavy breastplate bearing the Ironward crest, proof against a graveblade's edge.

items.name: Ironward Greaves
items.description: Level 15 plate. Articulated leg harness that takes a footman's charge without slowing it.

items.name: Ironward Pauldrons
items.description: Level 15 plate. Broad spaulders that turn a blow aimed at the collar — the T-420 shoulders slot made them wearable.

items.name: Arcanist Cowl
items.description: Level 15 robe. A deep midnight-blue cowl stitched with silver arcane thread — the mage set routes on armor_type "robe", not an id substring.

items.name: Arcanist Robe
items.description: Level 15 robe. Long midnight-blue mage vestments with silver rune trim, cut to keep a caster's arms free.

items.name: Arcanist Leggings
items.description: Level 15 robe. The draping lower skirts of an arcanist's robe, weighted so they hang true when the wearer moves.

items.name: Sanctified Hood
items.description: Level 15 vestment. An ivory ceremonial hood edged in gold orphrey — the priest set routes on armor_type "vestment".

items.name: Sanctified Vestment
items.description: Level 15 vestment. Ivory and gold priest chasuble, blessed cloth that turns more than the eye of the faithless.

items.name: Sanctified Skirts
items.description: Level 15 vestment. The draping lower skirts of an ivory-and-gold priest's vestments.

items.name: Clipped Shilling
items.description: A milled coin with its silver edge shaved thin — Syndicate scrip that spends anywhere on the street.

items.name: Bootleg Gin
items.description: An unlabelled bottle of bathtub gin cut with turpentine. Sells fast in the back rooms of Ashmoor.

items.name: Brass Knuckles
items.description: Level 20. Four cast-brass rings on a bar — a legbreaker's honest day's work.

items.name: Bent Truncheon
items.description: Level 20. A constable's hardwood baton, worn smooth where it has met too many jaws.

items.name: Séance Sigil Chalk
items.description: A nub of green-glowing chalk the wardens use to score binding circles. The rift never fully closed; this is how the age's masters keep talking to it.

items.name: The Threnody Cane
items.description: Level 20. A blackwood occultist's cane crowned with a gaslight-azure sigil disc. The mage's focus in the modern age — magic went hidden, and this is what a scholar of forbidden signs channels it through.

items.name: The Ashgrove Reliquary
items.description: Level 20. A brass hand-reliquary housing a warm relic behind glass. The medium's focus — a battlefield chaplain channels the good dead through it against the rift's echo.

items.name: Rift-Worn Traveler's Coat
items.description: Level 18. A heavy wool coat that came through the rift on your back — the first thing in Ashmoor that is honestly yours. The cut is a hundred years out of fashion here, and everyone can tell.

items.name: Dockside Lead Pipe
items.description: Level 20. A length of lead pipe, wrapped at one end — the Syndicate's favorite argument, now yours. Inelegant, deniable, and it swings true.

items.name: Osric's Warding Censer
items.description: Level 15. The parson's own censer, re-blessed for a hand that fights. Its smoke unsettles the risen dead.

items.name: Gravewarden's Hauberk
items.description: Level 16. Mail worn by the old wardens who once walled the Hollowing into the deepest Vault.

items.name: Ward Against the Hollowing
items.description: Level 16. A wax-sealed charm scored with Osric's binding sigils. It keeps the wrong hunger at arm's length.

items.name: Deepvault Warden's Hood
items.description: Level 17. A hooded leather coif smelling of cold stone and grave-lime, cut for the descent into the Vault.

items.name: Riftward Edge
items.description: Level 18. A last Era-1 blade quenched in warded water, honed for the thing waking behind the seal. The best steel the old age can hand you before the crossing.

items.name: Bloodthorn Sprig
items.description: A thorned red sprig from the bog's edge. An alchemist's staple.

items.name: Marshmint Leaf
items.description: Cool green leaves that grow where the forest meets standing water.

items.name: Emberroot
items.description: A warm, resinous root pulled from Ashmoor's scorched soil.

items.name: Venom Gland
items.description: A distended sac cut from a beast. Reagents like this bind a brew together.

items.name: Minor Healing Potion
items.description: A red draught that knits small wounds. Drink to restore health.

items.name: Greater Healing Potion
items.description: A potent brew that mends deep wounds. Drink to restore health.

items.name: Traveler's Ration
items.description: A hearty packed meal. Eat while safe to bank a little rested comfort.

items.name: Field Repair Kit
items.description: Whetstone, thread, and pitch. Mends worn gear in the field — rougher than a smith's bench.

items.name: Potent Healing Elixir
items.description: A searing crimson elixir distilled with a rare emberbloom. Drink to restore a great wound of health.

items.name: Gemset Charm
items.description: A rough gemstone cut and set into a banded charm — a smith's dream setting made real. Wards its bearer.

items.name: Heartwood Longbow
items.description: A longbow drawn from a dense heartwood bough — the resin-dark core prized for hafts and bows. Snaps true and hard.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: A heavy chunk of ore chipped from an exposed vein. The smithy's appetite.

items.name: Rough Timber
items.description: A split length of forest wood, good for hafts, grips, and backing boards.

items.name: Emberbloom
items.description: A rare crimson flower that sometimes opens among common sprigs. A potent alchemical reagent worth far more than the herbs it hides in.

items.name: Rough Gemstone
items.description: An uncut stone that occasionally tumbles free of a struck vein. Glittering, valuable, and a smith's dream setting.

items.name: Heartwood Bough
items.description: A dense, resin-dark length cut from the core of an old trunk. Rarely found, prized for hafts and bows.

items.name: Forgehand Broadsword
items.description: An honest crafted blade — a shade past the rack-bought iron sword, nothing a crypt won't out-drop.

items.name: Riveted Oak Buckler
items.description: Oak boards under a riveted copper boss. A crafter's first shield.

items.name: Smith's Repair Kit
items.description: Spare rivets, files, and tempered wire. A proper field mend — still short of the bench's full restore.

items.name: Rift Shardblade
items.description: T-538 rift band riftmarked (uncommon, tier 1+). A blade of fused rift-glass, edge humming faintly out of true.

items.name: Rift-Cracked Aegis
items.description: T-538 rift band riftmarked (uncommon, tier 1+). A buckler seamed with hairline fractures that never quite spread.

items.name: Hollowmark Helm
items.description: T-538 rift band riftmarked (uncommon, tier 1+). Rift-pitted iron that still turns a blow.

items.name: Riftdust Wraps
items.description: T-538 rift band riftmarked (uncommon, tier 1+). Shoulder wraps grey with the ash the rift leaves behind.

items.name: Veinsong Edge
items.description: T-538 rift band riftbound (rare, tier 5+). The metal sings on the backswing, a note only the rift can hear.

items.name: Echo Bulwark
items.description: T-538 rift band riftbound (rare, tier 5+). Each blow it stops echoes back a half-beat late.

items.name: Seer's Riftcrown
items.description: T-538 rift band riftbound (rare, tier 5+). Cold to the brow; the wearer sees the next tier before they reach it.

items.name: Gloaming Mantle
items.description: T-538 rift band riftbound (rare, tier 5+). Woven from the dim light at the rift's edge, heavier than it looks.

items.name: Riftforged Reaver
items.description: T-538 rift band riftforged (epic, tier 10+). Attack 22 — the rift-set ceiling (1.16x the rare edge), inside the T-353 epic index cap. Forged in the collapse between two tiers, its edge never dulls.

items.name: Paradox Ward
items.description: T-538 rift band riftforged (epic, tier 10+). A shield that was broken and whole in the same instant, and chose whole.

items.name: Ascendant Diadem
items.description: T-538 rift band riftforged (epic, tier 10+). Worn by those the ladder could not stop.

items.name: Singularity Plate
items.description: T-538 rift band riftforged (epic, tier 10+). Rift-dense steel; a blow that lands seems to fall inward and vanish.

items.name: Crystal Lake Perch
items.description: A firm, bright-scaled perch caught along Crystal Lake's reed beds.

items.name: Reed Minnow
items.description: A small lake fish that schools in the quiet shallows.

items.name: Crystalfin
items.description: An uncommon silver-blue fish whose fins catch the light like glass.

items.name: Pan-Fried Crystal Lake Fish
items.description: Fresh lake fish crisped over a hot pan. Eat while safe to bank rested comfort.

items.name: Gravewatch Shoulders
items.description: Level 3. Boiled leather a sexton's apprentice wore for the night watch.

items.name: Sexton's Lantern
items.description: Level 4. It burned all the way down the stair and never once went out.

items.name: Marrow's Bellhammer
items.description: Level 4. The striker that rang the shallow graves awake, gone quiet.
